description_en: This operation enables an endpoint of a specified type. After the endpoint is enabled, requests that originate from the endpoint and are on the Access Control List (ACL) whitelist are not blocked
description_zh: 本接口用于启用指定类型的接入点。开启后，源自对应接入点且处于Acl白名单中的请求都将不会被拦截
name: EnableEndpoint

parameters.help_en:
The type of the endpoint. Valid value:

- **public**: The Internet endpoint. Only public is supported
parameters.help_zh:
接入点类型。取值：

- **public**：表示公网接入点。(目前仅支持public)
parameters.name: endpoint_type
